description: This source file contains the implementation of a fault injection class for Azure Storage exceptions, and a custom exception class derived from RequestFailedException, utilized within the Orleans.Transactions testing framework. The class SimpleAzureStorageExceptionInjector can simulate storage exceptions before and after storage operations, useful for testing fault tolerance.

classes.name: SimpleAzureStorageExceptionInjector
classes.description: A class that injects simulated Azure Storage exceptions before and after storage operations for testing fault tolerance.

classes.name: SimpleAzureStorageException
classes.description: A custom exception class derived from RequestFailedException to represent simulated Azure Storage errors.

methods.name: AfterStore
methods.description: Injected after a storage operation, throws exception if InjectAfterStore is true.

methods.name: BeforeStore
methods.description: Injected before a storage operation, throws exception if InjectBeforeStore is true.
